name: ios-spm
description: iOS Swift Package Manager tooling for Xcode-managed SPM dependencies. Renovate can't natively update Package.resolved files inside .xcodeproj bundles (see renovatebot/renovate#9735), so this plugin fills the gap: discover outdated direct/transitive packages, apply picked bumps by editing project.pbxproj, refresh Package.resolved via xcodebuild -resolvePackageDependencies, optionally verify with a build, and open a PR with changelog summaries.
